apiToken.title: API Tokens
apiToken.description: Manage CDA (Content Delivery API) tokens for read-only access to published content.
apiToken.blankDescription: Create a CDA token to allow external applications to fetch published content.
apiToken.generalDesc: Basic information about the API token.
apiToken.accessDesc: Control what this token can do and which sites it can reach.
apiToken.scopeHint: Read: published content only. Preview: also unpublished drafts. Write: read plus write-back through the CDA.
apiToken.scopePreviewDesc: Read published content and unpublished drafts.
apiToken.scopeWriteDesc: Read plus write content back through the Content Delivery API.
apiToken.envHint: Production keys read only published content; preview keys also read unpublished drafts (draft-preferred). Point the same front-end at either with only a token swap.
apiToken.envPreviewDesc: Reads draft-preferred content — sees unpublished edits before they go live.
apiToken.siteAccessHint: When off, the token can only read the sites you select below.
apiToken.siteAccessDesc: Select the sites this token is allowed to read.
apiToken.descriptionPlaceholder: e.g. Used by the frontend to fetch published content.
apiToken.tokenDesc: The generated CDA token value. Use this in the Key header for API requests.
apiToken.enabledHint: Disable to temporarily revoke access without deleting the token.
apiToken.created: API token created. Copy the token value below.

apiToken.scopeAgentDesc: Writes through the agent surface (/api/v2/agent, /mcp) and reads drafts. Not a CDA write key: it cannot patch published content directly.
apiToken.mayPublishHint: Off by default. An agent token without this writes drafts a human then approves in Agent Review.
device.title: My devices
device.description: Device tokens let the Shio app act as you without storing your password. Revoke one and that device is signed out on its next call.
device.addHint: Name the device so you can recognise it here. Its token is shown once.
device.name: Device name
device.mintedHint: Paste it into the app. It will not be shown again; if you lose it, revoke the device and add it again.
device.blankDescription: Add a device to sign the Shio app in as you, including when you sign in with single sign-on.
